name: Lieutenant Bhondu
description: a very tall skinny Pixar-style 3D alien, soft sky-blue skin, a long noodle neck, a small round head with huge gentle glossy brown eyes, one droopy antenna with a soft yellow tip, a loose grey uniform that is too short at the wrists and ankles, a shy permanent smile
voice: slow sweet sing-song tenor, Hindi, innocent and sincere, always starts with 'Sir ji'
signature: holds a samosa in both long hands, starts lines with 'Sir ji', and closes most reels by asking the viewer one open question

images.anchor: not yet generated. Generate in Gemini using prompts.md, accept one, then set frozen to true.

notes: The heart of the show and the reason Dhamaka learns to laugh. Keep him tall so the two-shot with Dhamaka reads at a glance. He delivers the 6-second closing question that ends most reels (the 'stinger'): an open-ended question to the viewer, never a request to comment a word, tag or share.
